## Contributing

Thanks for helping maintain the EdgeGamers Source2Script plugins. The
[developer guide](../docs/developer-guide.md) covers setup, branches, local
validation, Changesets, review, promotion, and the hotfix workflow.

Report vulnerabilities through the process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), and
follow the expectations in [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
